unit: one complete time-resolved pass (n = 22 passes); adjacent time samples and grid rows are not independent

item1_per_pass_whole_pass_rms_and_ratios.definition: whole-pass RMS sqrt(mean(residual^2)) per model, one value per pass; ratio X/Y computed pass-by-pass; median and full distribution over the 22 passes
item1_per_pass_whole_pass_rms_and_ratios.augmented_note: orthogonalised variant: each model is first linearly residualised per pass on the other two models (e.g. A = a*B + b*C + c + r_A) so that the compared number is the model's additional content beyond the other two

item2_blocked_paired_tests_over_22_passe.definition: paired tests across the 22 passes (the independent unit); lower RMS = winner

item3_whole_pass_bootstrap_median_ratio.definition: whole-pass bootstrap: resample the 22 passes with replacement, recompute the median ratio each time; percentile CI; fraction of resamples with ratio < 1

item4_leave_one_pass_out_median_ratio.definition: leave-one-pass-out sensitivity of the median ratio (22 deletions)

item5_robustness_alternative_definitions.definition: robustness of the B < C < A ordering by median whole-pass ratio under alternative definitions

item6_pooled_linear_relations_between_mo.definition: pooled OLS across all 1698 samples (pooling is for coefficient estimation only; uncertainty is bootstrapped over the 22 passes, never over samples)

item7_pearson_correlation_matrices.note: sample-level correlations use all 1698 samples and are descriptive only; those samples are NOT independent replicates (adjacent samples are strongly autocorrelated within a pass)

item8_pass_level_cross_validation.definition: leave-one-pass-out cross-validation at the pass level: coefficients fitted on the pooled samples of the OTHER 21 passes, prediction error evaluated on the held-out pass only; ratio = out-of-sample RMS / held-out model's own RMS
